verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own headless tooling that fits CI automation. The official sentry-cli handles debug information files, releases and source maps. The web API gives programmatic access to manage resources and export data. A Bitbucket Pipelines integration notifies Sentry of new builds. However, the evidence never documents a dedicated CI/headless workflow, and the CLI's scope is described as mainly release and artifact management. Missing for 10: explicit CI usage docs (auth tokens, CI-provider guides), breadth of headless operations beyond releases and source maps, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: It’s primarily used for managing debug information files for iOS, Android, release and source maps management, as well as code mappings for other platforms.
Deploy notifications and source map uploads.
Automatically notify Sentry of new Bitbucket Pipelines builds.
The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
